name: agent_summarize
description: Ask one of your delegated children for an on-demand summary of where it stands. Same mechanism as agent_ask: it returns an ask_id at once, the request is the child's next turn, and the summary is what the child itself sends back quoting the ask_id, which reaches you as mail and triggers your next turn. The child sees it as a summary request, not a question. If the child ends without answering, an exited notice quoting the ask_id tells you so. Only your OWN children may be summarized.

focus.description: What the summary should cover — the question the summary must answer for you ("what is blocking you", "which files have you changed and why").

harp.description: The child session harp to summarize (from agent_run's harp, or the roster)

outputSchema.description: Answers a question or summarize ask at once, before the child has read it.

ask_id.description: The ask's id. The child's answer quotes it in in_reply_to, and so does the exited notice if the child ends without answering.
